technique_name: Write a paragraph explaining why you deserve a good grade in a course.
description: I believe I deserve a good grade in this course because I have put in a great amount of effort throughout the semester. I have attended every lecture, completed all the readings, and carefully followed all of the instructor's instructions. I have always engaged in class discussions, used critical thinking to answer questions, and offered thoughtful insights.
